_about: Verdicts by Claude (one reader, not independently reviewed) for the 10 issues kept by one plain-prompt run on NodeGoat [all comments removed], gemini-3.1-flash-lite, 2026-10-18. Read against the NodeGoat source.

app/data/user-dao.js:25.note: mechanical scorer also credited login-user-enumeration; the claim is only about storage

app/routes/benefits.js:29.note: same root cause (no admin check on the benefits routes), framed around the update; the 'unauthenticated' wording is loose because isLoggedIn is present

app/routes/error.js:10.note: raw error object rendered into the page

app/views/profile.html:78.note: an instance of the XSS family (a user value in an href with escaping off); the labelled bug is the global autoescape setting, which another finding states. The mechanical scorer credited no-csrf here, wrongly

config/config.js:12.note: prints the whole config, including secrets, to the console

package.json:17.note: outdated dependencies with known vulnerabilities (marked 0.3.5 and others); real, not labelled
